thread:
Sofia: quick bring-up for opal12b candidate. ran int4 (GPTQ+), int6 (AWQ), int8, and fp16 baselines on rerank-heavy workload + GTN slice. sharing highlights + recommended traffic split.

Sofia: perf (mixed real traffic sample, batch=1, seq=1536):
```
int4-GPTQ+: tp 18.6 req/s, p50 35ms, p95 120ms, p99 260ms, cost ~$0.016 / 1k tokens
int6-AWQ  : tp 14.2 req/s, p50 44ms, p95 160ms, p99 340ms, cost ~$0.024 / 1k tokens
int8      : tp 12.8 req/s, p50 50ms, p95 180ms, p99 400ms, cost ~$0.032 / 1k tokens
fp16      : tp 9.1 req/s, p50 70ms, p95 260ms, p99 610ms, cost ~$0.055 / 1k tokens
```

Sofia: quality (GTN 12k samples focused on rerank + factuality):
- fp16 baseline fact_precision 0.882, NDCG@10 0.742
- int8 fact_precision 0.877 (-0.5 pts), NDCG@10 0.739 (-0.003)
- int6 fact_precision 0.869 (-1.3 pts), NDCG@10 0.732 (-0.010)
- int4 fact_precision 0.854 (-2.8 pts), NDCG@10 0.711 (-0.031)

Tom: notable: int4 reduces cost ~3x vs fp16 but factuality drop is concentrated on multi-document merge cases and list aggregation. single-doc rerank unaffected.

Isha: product question 1: are hallucinations user-visible? we measured hallucination climb in rerank outputs where model synthesizes unsupported facts in summaries. severity: medium for advanced search features.

Sofia: yes. user-visible on long aggregations and chain-of-thought style answers. short QA and plain rerank ranking are OK.

Ben: ops observed an alignment drift for int4 under burst traffic: some tokens decoded incorrectly when the KV stride wasn't aligned after quant-blocking. filed ML-901. need KV-cache alignment patch.

Tom: routing suggestion: keep fp16/int8 for rerank-and-summarize pipelines; allow int6 for conversational and int4 only for cheap single-turn completion endpoints with strict post-filtering.

Sofia: proposed rollout config (example):
```json
{"model":"opal12b","routes":[{"name":"rerank+summarize","weightings":{"fp16":0.7,"int8":0.3},"pin":true},{"name":"chat-short","weightings":{"int6":0.8,"int8":0.2}},{"name":"cheap-complete","weightings":{"int4":0.9,"int6":0.1},"postfilter":"factuality"}],"fallback":"int8","canary_samples":6000}
```

Isha: gating criteria for GTN smoke (48h):
- fact_precision absolute drop <= 0.8 pts vs fp16 on rerank slice
- NDCG@10 drop <= 0.01 absolute
- p99 latency <= 350ms
- client-visible error rate <= 0.15%
If any fail for rerank route -> rollback to int8/fp16 immediately.

Tom: mitigation notes: post-quant calibration narrows int6->int8 gap by ~0.4 pts fact_precision; distillation-lite (5k steps with synthetic targets) recovers ~0.9 pts for int4 on rerank tests but costs ~4 TPU hrs.

Ben: ops checklist before canary: KV-cache alignment PR, canary quota + shadow run 8h, add rerank-specific monitors (fact_precision, ndcg10, hallucination-alerts). Scheduling tentatively 2025-02-25 03:00 UTC.

Sofia: decision recs for GTN docs:
- immediate: enable int6 for chat-short + pin int8/fp16 for rerank+summarize. keep int4 off for rerank until distillation + calibration complete.
- short-term: run distillation-lite + post-quant calibrate on int4, then 50k-sample GTN focused on multi-doc merges.
- long-term: evaluate mixed-precision decode path (prefix int4, decode int8) to try to reclaim factuality while keeping cost.

Isha: I'll draft the product-facing acceptance criteria + user-impact summary.

Tom: I'll own the distillation job and coordinate infra. ETA 6 days for first pass.

Ben: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: opal12b-int6-chat-short -> 2025-02-25T03:00Z, samples=6000, owner=Ben. Monitoring: rerank-fact_precision, ndcg10, latency, errors.

Sofia: tagging @Tom @Isha @Ben 1 pls post canary readout in this thread. overall stance: aggressive cost savings for cheap completions (int4 OK with filters), conservative approach for rerank/factual features (pin to int8/fp16). :raised_hands:
